root_cause.summary: During candidate evaluation in scripts/git/auto_integrator.py, live integration execution (--execute) enforces require_dedicated_integration_path=True (line 3433). Candidate discovery sets dedicated_integration_path = bool(resolved_repo.get('integration_path')) (line 607). In the live supervisor runtime configuration at /home/chloe_ong_dev_cctech_support_com/pantheon-ci-deploy/runtime/live-supervisor-mainroot-config.json prior to promotion at 05:10Z, coordination.repositories.pantheon lacked an explicit integration_path entry. Consequently, dedicated_integration_path evaluated to False for PR #5914 (head c319b6dc048a3affda842e89d52c24629d598381), triggering the fail-closed rejection at auto_integrator.py:2319-2324 with reason 'missing-dedicated-integration-path' and opening this unblock task.
root_cause.configuration_source: The missing integration_path stemmed from the live supervisor runtime configuration at /home/chloe_ong_dev_cctech_support_com/pantheon-ci-deploy/runtime/live-supervisor-mainroot-config.json, where coordination.repositories.pantheon had not yet been provisioned with the dedicated integration checkout under pantheon-ci-deploy/integration-runtimes/pantheon/<SHA>. Following promotion of command runtime b435986b13d5c323c533225f5ea3f6481d79a1be at 05:08Z, live-supervisor-mainroot-config.json was updated at 05:10Z with integration_path='/home/chloe_ong_dev_cctech_support_com/pantheon-ci-deploy/integration-runtimes/pantheon/b435986b13d5c323c533225f5ea3f6481d79a1be', which exists and is isolated.
root_cause.integrator_behavior: scripts/git/auto_integrator.py operated exactly as designed. Per docs/operations/auto-integrator.md § Safety Model and scripts/git/auto_integrator_contract.md, live execution strictly requires a dedicated, isolated checkout for merge operations (coordination.repositories.<id>.integration_path) to prevent destructive merges or race conditions against shared worker or coordination worktrees (such as coordination-root, where ai-status.json is actively mutated). By failing closed with 'missing-dedicated-integration-path', auto_integrator.py prevented unsafe merge attempts against unisolated paths.
root_cause.recursive_unblock_trigger: Because PR #5914 delivered root-cause analysis for PR #5911 in repository 'pantheon' and was review-approved, auto-integrator attempted to merge PR #5914 in live mode. Because the live configuration at the time of execution still lacked a dedicated integration_path for 'pantheon', auto-integrator rejected PR #5914 with the same 'missing-dedicated-integration-path' safety check and generated this unblock task.
